kv_precision_lever.note: fp8 KV halves bytes/token. It is a CONCURRENCY lever (memory), not a speed lever: e2e decode-speed ceiling <=0.2% (kv_serving/, full attn = 2.67% of runtime), but it roughly doubles max concurrency at fixed memory and re-opens dual-residency headroom on large-memory parts.

policy_b_repack.verdict: feasible only at engine-mode granularity (seconds-minutes); infeasible per-phase (~100 ms) or per-layer

policy_c_jit_dequant.verdict: never pays; in-kernel JIT is the r_dequant ceiling CARM already prices

conclusion: quantized-primary storage + per-shape kernel choice is the only zero-marginal-cost dispatch; bf16-primary dispatch is memory-infeasible (80 GB) or switch-period-limited
